items.question: How many products are in the catalog?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products;

items.question: Which countries do we sell to in Asia Pacific?
items.sql:
WITH apac_countries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.code AS country_code,
    c.name AS country_name
  FROM order_line_revenue ol
  JOIN countries c ON ol.country_code = c.code
  JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
  WHERE r.code = 'APAC'
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  country_name
FROM apac_countries
ORDER BY country_name;

items.question: How many support tickets are still open or pending?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_pending_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending');

items.question: What was total net revenue in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS total_net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';

items.question: What is the average net order value in 2026 so far?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS average_net_order_value
FROM filtered;

items.question: How much subscription revenue did we invoice and collect in 2025?

items.question: What was net revenue by product category in 2025?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT category_name, net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_line_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT

  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd

items.question: How many delivery support tickets did each EU country have in calendar Q3 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT
    c.country_code AS country_code,
    COUNT(*) AS delivery_ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN customers c ON st.customer_id = c.id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
WHERE st.category = 'delivery'
  AND st.created_at >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND st.created_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND r.code = 'EU'
GROUP BY c.country_code
ORDER BY delivery_ticket_count DESC, country_code;

items.question: What net revenue was attributed to each campaign for orders in 2026, by campaign name?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT orv.campaign_id, orv.net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_revenue orv
  WHERE orv.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND orv.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT c.name AS campaign_name,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM filtered f
JOIN campaigns c ON f.campaign_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC;

items.question: What was the average resolution time in hours of support tickets by region in 2026?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        st.region_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600 AS resolution_hours
    FROM support_tickets st
    WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
      AND st.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND st.created_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT
    r.code AS region_code,
    r.name AS region_name,
    ROUND(AVG(f.resolution_hours)::numeric, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM filtered f
JOIN regions r ON r.id = f.region_id
GROUP BY r.code, r.name
ORDER BY r.code;

items.question: Show monthly net revenue for the last 12 months
items.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(net_revenue_usd, 2) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql:
WITH q3 AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_q3
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY region_code
),
q2 AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_q2
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY region_code
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(q3.region_code, q2.region_code) AS region_code,
  ROUND(q3.net_revenue_q3, 2) AS net_revenue_q3_2026,
  ROUND(q2.net_revenue_q2, 2) AS net_revenue_q2_2026,
  ROUND(COALESCE(q3.net_revenue_q3, 0) - COALESCE(q2.net_revenue_q2, 0), 2) AS difference,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(q2.net_revenue_q2, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(q3.net_revenue_q3, 0) - COALESCE(q2.net_revenue_q2, 0)) / NULLIF(q2.net_revenue_q2, 0), 4)
  END AS pct_change
FROM q3
FULL OUTER JOIN q2 ON q3.region_code = q2.region_code
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_q2,
    CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_q3
  FROM order_revenue
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  SUM(in_q2) AS orders_q2,
  SUM(in_q3) AS orders_q3,
  SUM(in_q3) - SUM(in_q2) AS order_diff,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(in_q2) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(in_q3) - SUM(in_q2))::numeric / SUM(in_q2) END, 4) AS order_pct_change
FROM filtered
GROUP BY region_code
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: What was the refund rate in each region in 2025 compared with 2026 so far?
items.sql:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN refund_usd END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN gross_revenue_usd END), 0) AS rate_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN refund_usd END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN gross_revenue_usd END), 0) AS rate_2026
  FROM order_revenue
  GROUP BY region_code
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  ROUND(rate_2025, 4) AS refund_rate_2025,
  ROUND(rate_2026, 4) AS refund_rate_2026,
  ROUND(rate_2026 - rate_2025, 4) AS refund_rate_diff,
  CASE
    WHEN rate_2025 IS NULL OR rate_2025 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((rate_2026 - rate_2025) / rate_2025, 4)
  END AS pct_change
FROM rates
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: Which 10 products had the most units sold in 2026 so far?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT product_id, product_name, units
  FROM order_line_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  SUM(units) AS total_units
FROM filtered

items.question: Which customers placed the most orders in 2025? Show the top 5, including anyone tied with the fifth.
items.sql:
WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_2025
  FROM order_revenue o
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    co.customer_id,
    cp.customer_name,
    co.orders_2025,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.orders_2025 DESC) AS order_rank
  FROM cust_orders co
  JOIN customer_profile cp ON cp.customer_id = co.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  orders_2025
FROM ranked
WHERE order_rank <= 5
ORDER BY order_rank, orders_2025 DESC, customer_id;

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?
items.sql:
WITH jan2025_first AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_order_at
  FROM customer_profile
  WHERE first_order_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND first_order_at < DATE '2025-02-01'
),
repeat_within_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT j.customer_id
  FROM jan2025_first j
  JOIN order_revenue o
    ON o.customer_id = j.customer_id
   AND o.ordered_at > j.first_order_at
   AND o.ordered_at <= j.first_order_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_repeat_within_90d
FROM repeat_within_90;

items.question: What share of customers who signed up in 2024 placed at least one order in 2026?
items.sql:
WITH signed_up_2024 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customer_profile
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
ordered_2026 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM order_revenue
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS customers_2024_signed_up,
    COUNT(o.customer_id) AS customers_2024_with_order_2026,
    ROUND(COUNT(o.customer_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS share_2024_to_2026_order
FROM signed_up_2024
LEFT JOIN ordered_2026 o USING (customer_id);

items.question: What was the net revenue after refunds of the Aurora Smart Bulb (Gen 1) products in 2025?

    SELECT olr.net_revenue_usd
    FROM order_line_revenue olr

      AND olr.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'

items.question: Among products with at least 100 units sold in 2025, which one had the highest refund rate?
items.sql:
WITH product_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    SUM(units) AS units_sold,
    SUM(gross_revenue_usd) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    SUM(refund_usd) AS refund_usd
  FROM order_line_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  units_sold,
  ROUND(gross_revenue_usd, 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(refund_usd, 2) AS refund_usd,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN gross_revenue_usd = 0 THEN NULL ELSE refund_usd / gross_revenue_usd END, 4) AS refund_rate
FROM product_2025
WHERE units_sold >= 100
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

items.question: How many customers have no known acquisition channel?
At which local hour of the day did APAC customers place the most orders in 2025?
items.sql:
WITH apac_orders AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (orv.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE r.timezone))::int AS local_hour
    FROM order_revenue orv
    JOIN regions r ON orv.region_code = r.code
    WHERE orv.region_code = 'APAC'
      AND orv.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND orv.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
    local_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM apac_orders
GROUP BY local_hour
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
